Title: Private AKS clusters are now generally available in Azure Government

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) private clusters are now generally available to Azure Government customers (US federal, state, and local governments and their partners) in three US Government regions (Virginia, Texas, and Arizona).

Azure Government customers can now build private AKS clusters to ensure that network traffic between the API server and node pools is restricted to the private network in a dedicated cloud that meets stringent government security and compliance requirements.
